name: fullscreen-button
title: Fullscreen button
description: A toggle for fullscreen on any element: icon and label follow the real state, Escape works as the browser makes it, and it hides where unsupported.
docs: Mark the element with data-fullscreen-root or pass target, and keep the button inside it. iPhone Safari cannot expand an element: pass fallback to cover the viewport instead, or the button renders nothing there. With words on it the name is the visible label; the icon-only button keeps one name and uses aria-pressed.
